comparison.objective: Insert a server chassis into rails, versus tune a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual chassis/rail alignment and constrained insertion versus small-tool alignment, collar adjustment, force-limited locking, and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Chassis seated on/in rails versus two non-bottoming stops with bounded rebound, overload, travel, and drift.
comparison.reason: Both can require alignment and bimanual control, but the essential mechanisms and tested outcomes differ. Body and specs are absent.
